text:
anya: heads-up: ran into a puzzling Rollup+Vite combo when trying to publish the new TS sample that demonstrates auth retries + edge deploys. reproducible steps + logs below.

anya: symptoms: dev server (vite) works. `vite build` -> bundle served in edge runtime -> runtime errors: `TypeError: RedwoodClient is not a constructor` and TS types missing in editor when using `import RedwoodClient from '@redwood/inference'`.

brian: did you test named imports?

anya: yep, `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` fails at runtime: `The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.esm.js' does not provide an export named 'RedwoodClient'`. weird because package.json has `module` -> dist/index.esm.js and `types` -> dist/index.d.ts.

olga: could be the ESM bundle is an ES default of a pre-instantiated instance (e.g., `export default new Client()`) while d.ts declares a class export -> type mismatch. what does dist/index.esm.js actually export?

anya: snippet from dist (shortened):
```js
// dist/index.esm.js
const client = new Client({});
export default client;
```
and dist/index.d.ts declares `export class RedwoodClient {}`

brian: yeah that's an auth/packaging bug. consumer code expecting `new RedwoodClient()` will break. but why does dev server work? Vite dev sometimes resolves CJS fallback or uses SSR-happy loader that masks it. Production build + rollup/terser reveals the mismatch.

anya: repro steps I committed to a tiny repo:
1) pnpm create vite@latest repro -- --template react-ts
2) pnpm add @redwood/inference@0.9.1 rollup@3 vite@4
3) src/main.tsx: `import RedwoodClient from '@redwood/inference'` + `const c = new RedwoodClient()`
4) pnpm build && serve dist in Cloudflare worker/miniflare (edge-like).
5) observe error in console.

olga: aside — we also saw auth retry failure when SDK does fetch + reconsume Request body in edge runtimes. Edge Request bodies are one-shot. Did you see "Body has already been used"?

anya: yes, intermittent. stack: `Body.throwIfUsed -> fetch`. On a retry path the SDK calls `await req.text()` and then reuses that Request; that fails. workaround used in repro: buffer body on first use and reattach clones:
```js
async function cloneBody(req){
  const buf = await req.arrayBuffer();
  return () => new Request(req.url, {method: req.method, headers: req.headers, body: buf.slice(0)});
}
```

brian: for packaging fix: SDK should export the class as named export and potentially default-export the class too (not a pre-instantiated object). Also make sure `exports` map in package.json lists `import` entry pointing to the ESM source that `export { RedwoodClient }` (or `export default RedwoodClient`). d.ts should match runtime shape.

olga: for type/IDE issues: editors pick up `types` field; if `types` points to a `.d.ts` that exports a class, but runtime exports a default instance, you'll get compile-time OK but runtime crash. So both must be in sync.

anya: observed bundler behavior: Rollup + terser produced a mangled wrapper that changed `.default` -> `.d` in one minified chunk, so constructor call became `(0,_inference.default)()` which ends up being undefined after mangle. disabling property mangling fixed it but that's not acceptable for users.

brian: suggested mitigation steps in thread: 
- SDK: publish patch v0.9.2 with ESM entry that exports named and default *class* (not instance). Update `exports` map and `types`.
- SDK CI: add smoke matrix job: Vite build, Rollup build, Webpack prod build against a tiny consumer and assert import shape: `typeof imported.RedwoodClient === 'function' || typeof imported.default === 'function'`.
- Devex/sampleapps: add a short import-robustness shim until SDK patch lands:
```js
const _r = await import('@redwood/inference');
const ClientCtor = _r.RedwoodClient || _r.default?.RedwoodClient || _r.default || _r;
const client = new ClientCtor({auth: KEY});
```

olga: retry/body recommendations: SDK should accept `body` as ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array or accept `bodyFactory: () => BodyLike` option so callers in edge envs can provide a factory that returns a fresh readable stream each retry. Also offer an opt-in `bufferBodyForRetries: boolean` which copies body for you (noticeable memory cost).

anya: added minimal failing test to repro repo: `yarn test:bundle` runs vite/rollup and then runs node to import the built ESM file and asserts `typeof defaultExport === 'function'`. It fails. Attached logs in ticket.

devex-ci: auto-created issue RW-2567 labels: devex,sdk,rollup,vite,types,priority=P2. CI artifacts uploaded.

brian: I'll open a PR against SDK repo with quick patch: change `src/index.ts` to `export class RedwoodClient { ... } export default RedwoodClient;` and update build to not emit pre-instantiated default. Also add types parity check in release CI.

olga: I'll add a short note to sampleapps README: "If your edge deploy errors with `is not a constructor`, try guarded import or pin SDK to v0.9.1 until patch lands."

anya: thanks all. leaving repro link in issue and enabling triage watch. ping me if you want the miniflare script. :pray:
